scope: All 19 hand-drawn raster illustrations displayed by the English and Russian nigiri recipes, including hero, ingredient cards, preparation, shaping panels/insets and serving.
method: Direct manual visual inspection of every generated illustration at full size and of final optimized assets. Check style consistency, instructional food orientation/contact/motion and one thumb plus four fingers per hand. Naturally cropped/occluded digits are recorded explicitly. Hash tests verify coverage/freshness, not anatomical correctness.
style: Warm hand-drawn Japanese animation, thin brown outlines, matte cel shading; no photorealistic skin or geometric blueprints.
